292 STUDIOS ABOUT & ARTIST STATEMENT 02

VISHNU KUMAR

FOUNDER & LEAD PHOTOGRAPHER

Based in Sayreville, New Jersey, I specialize in commercial studio portraiture, modern headshots, and creative storytelling. From an early passion for visual arts to producing high-impact campaigns, my approach centers on translating dynamic concepts into imagery that is not just seen, but felt.

At 292 STUDIOS, every shoot is guided by rigorous technical precision—sculpting light to flatter natural contours, ensuring exact color calibration, and capturing authentic human expression across artists, dancers, professionals, and automotive enthusiasts.

STUDIO LIGHTING

Multi-point strobes, diffused modifiers, and shadow control tailored to skin and silhouette.

COLOR ACCURACY

Strict color profiles and calibration for seamless digital, social, and print fidelity.

HIGH-END RETOUCHING

Preserving authentic skin texture while removing distractions and balancing tones.

DIGITAL WORKFLOW

Structured digital asset management (DAM) ensuring swift turnaround and asset security.
